mapper.insert: INSERT INTO banned_users( user_id, section_id, ban_reason) values (#{userId}, #{sectionId}, #{banReason})
mapper.select: SELECT bu.id, u.username AS userName, s.name AS sectionName, bu.ban_reason AS banReason, bu.created_at AS createdAt FROM banned_users bu INNER JOIN users u ON bu.user_id = u.id INNER JOIN sections s ON bu.section_id = s.id WHERE bu.section_id = #{sectionId} ORDER BY bu.created_at DESC
